subject: Slider support for leaflet in Rstudio

messages.author: 89a8f3d53f34ca81
messages.subject: Slider support for leaflet in Rstudio
parts:
Hi,
I was wondering if anyone has been able to put slider controls directly in a leaflet map, similar to this example:
http://dwilhelm89.github.io/LeafletSlider/
I know I can do it by wrapping my leaflet in a Shiny app, but I'd rather be able to produce a leaflet object outside of Shiny that I can save as a free-standing html file.
Is there any way to do this by calling e.g. the L.control.sliderControl function from within the R leaflet statements?
Grateful for any help!
Best,
Martin
